channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Young people in Japan more inclined to have AI companion but skeptical of quality
item.description: More young people in Japan are turning to AI as a social companion despite not viewing it as "high quality," a new study has found.

item.title: Rapidus may get ¥54 billion tax exemption on Hokkaido plant transfer
item.description: The plant will be transferred to a government-backed agency in 2027, which will then transfer it to Rapidus and receive Rapidus shares in exchange.

item.title: Takaichi and Putin meet on APEC sidelines amid ongoing tensions
item.description: It was the first meeting between the leaders of Japan and Russia in seven years and the first since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

item.title: Osaka governments broadly OK draft design of metropolis plan
item.description: The plan mainly calls for reorganizing the prefectural capital into special wards like those of Tokyo.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
